sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
A Shuriken Wheel Prosthetic Tool, fitted to the Shinobi Prosthetic. Costs Spirit Emblems to use.
Pull a shuriken loaded into the wheel and launch it at the target in a single, flowing motion. The swiftly thrown shuriken damage enemy Vitality and Posture, particularly against those with a tendency to take to the air.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
Unlocked by giving the Shuriken Wheel to the Sculptor. It is found in Ashina Outskirts after the Outskirts Wall - Gate Path Sculptor's Idol, on the upper floor of a gatehouse behind a broken wall.
In its most basic form, the Loaded Shuriken serves as a straightforward ranged projectile attack for Wolf that can be thrown rapidly, though their most effective use are often the few well-timed shots. The use of Shuriken is instantaneous and among the fastest of Prosthetic Tools. Loaded Shuriken by itself is not a reliable weapon to eliminate Vitality or Posture and mostly serves as a side weapon that thrives on the situation it is used rather than the frequency, among these uses are:
- Interrupting enemies that are recovering their Posture
- As a weapon to take out fragile but otherwise dangerous enemies that are too nimble for Kusabimaru (eg. Shinobi Dogs)
- As a mean to interrupt mid-air enemies; the fact that there's a universal law in the game where Projectile attacks do considerably more damage vs entities who are mid-air adds to the reward of undeflected Shuriken
Spinning Shuriken is an upgrade that adds an alternative projectile mode that can be fired by holding the Prosthetic button. These spinning shurikens would violently grind the enemy before releasing a final burst that deals roughly the same damage as a normal throw, cumulating in a considerably higher vitality and posture damage than a regular throw. Having a wind-up, these throws are harder to time against mid-air opponents but does wonders against weaker enemies considering it cost the same amount of Spirit Emblem as a normal throw.
Gouging Top adds upon the feature of the Spinning Shuriken where the alternative throw inflicts damage through Guard, making it a straightforward and somewhat useful upgrade that gives the Shuriken some use as a means to help wear down the vitality and posture of even the most reactive enemies.
Lazulite Shuriken is a powerful upgrade that considerably increases the damage of thrown shurikens and makes them able to go through enemies, hitting those behind them; for the spinning throw, the shuriken will pierce through enemy at the conclusive burst. Although the piercing effect is very unlikely useful in many situation, the damage increase of Lazulite Shuriken at the same Spirit Emblem cost easily makes the other non-deviating upgrade of the Loaded Shuriken obsolete against this upgrade.
Phantom Kunai is a deviating upgrade that changes the way the tools is used (and also the type of projectile fired), instead of a shuriken, Wolf would throw a Kunai that after hitting a target would have illusory orbs home at the target. Holding the Prosthetic button would increase the number of orbs. There is a certain distance that the orbs need before being able to properly track targets, thus a target being too close to Wolf would have the orbs fail to home.
Sen Throw is a peculiar deviating upgrade that changes the projectile into literal Sen that Wolf carries, costing him both Spirit Emblems and the game currency to use. The Sen are thrown in a horizontally spreading trajectory: the further Sen travels, the more spread apart they are from each other, meaning the throw would inflict more damage the closer the target is. The amount of Sen Wolf is carrying would determine the amount of Sen he would shoot with with both the normal and held Prosthetic button.

sections.heading: Ability
sections.text: Shuriken Throw: Attack by throwing a shuriken. Costs 1 1 Spirit Emblem to use.

sections.heading: Spinning Shuriken
sections.text:
An enhanced Shuriken that can be empowered with rotational energy. Costs Spirit Emblems to use.
Damage an enemy's Vitality and Posture, and does huge damage to jumping enemies. Taking a moment to further bend the spring and build rotational energy will cause the blade to rotate after landing, damaging the enemy multiple times on hit.
Similar to a spinning top, but with blades.
Prerequisites | None
Upgrade Cost | 200 200
Scrap Iron x3
Spirit Emblem Cost | 1 1 Spirit Emblem
Shuriken Throw
Attack by throwing a shuriken.
(Hold) Spinning Shuriken Throw
Charge the rotational power of the shuriken before throwing. Hits the enemy multiple times.

sections.heading: Gouging Top
sections.text:
An enhanced shuriken that pierces enemies with its sharp blades. Costs Spirit Emblems to use.
These piercing blades retain momentum after landing, and will damage an enemy's Vitality and Posture, even if guarded. Taking a moment to further bend the spring, and build rotational energy will cause the blade to rotate after landing, damaging the enemy multiple times on hit.
Prerequisites | Spinning Shuriken
Loaded Spear Thrust Type
Upgrade Cost | 600 600
Scrap Magnetite x3
Spirit Emblem Cost | 1 1 Spirit Emblem
Shuriken Throw
Attack by throwing a shuriken. It has a penetrating effect that damages Vitality and Posture even when guarded.
(Hold) Spinning Shuriken Throw
Charge the rotational power of the shuriken before throwing. Hits the enemy multiple times.

sections.heading: Sen Throw
sections.text:
A Prosthetic Tool that shoots loaded coin bundles. Costs sen and Spirit Emblems to use.
While it lacks a shuriken's range, it inflicts far more damage, as the coins hit multiple times. The amount of coins thrown increases depending on how much money one possesses. Being rich makes the blast incredibly strong, but an empty purse will shoot nothing but dust.
Prerequisites | Spinning Shuriken
Loaded Spear Thrust Type
Gouging Top
Upgrade Cost | 2000 2000
Scrap Iron x4
Adamantite Scrap x4
Scrap Magnetite x4
Spirit Emblem Cost | 2 2 Spirit Emblems
Sen Throw
Throw coins.
(Hold) Raining Money
Scatters a large amount of sen
The amount of sen thrown varies depending on how much is in your possession.
"The dirt poor throw dust,
The poor throws a little money,
The rich throw a lot of money,
and the filthy rich throw enough money
to make all the rest cry."

sections.heading: Phantom Kunai
sections.text:
Lady Butterfly's kunai, fitted into the shuriken wheel. Costs Spirit Emblems to use.
Creates a special sound when thrown, which causes phantom butterflies to follow the path of the kunai. The phantom butterflies chase after enemies and inflict damage even when guarded.
Prerequisites | Spinning Shuriken
Spring-load Axe
Aged Feather Mist Raven
Upgrade Cost | 1000 1000
Phantom Kunai (Upgrade Material)
Lump of Fat Wax x3
Scrap Iron x6
Scrap Magnetite x3
Spirit Emblem Cost | 2 2 Spirit Emblems
Phantom Butterflies
Phantom butterflies fly out after throwing kunai. The phantom butterflies chase after enemies and can also inflict damage to guarding enemies.
(Hold) Swarming Dance
Charge to release more butterflies.

sections.heading: Lazulite Shuriken
sections.text:
Shuriken blessed with the favor of the Fountainhead Lapis Lazuli. Costs Spirit Emblems to use.
Its piercing edge heavily damages Vitality, and damages Vitality and Posture even if guarded. These blades do not slow down, even after striking an enemy.
The lazulite blue trail of light it emits in fight is reminiscent of a shooting star.
